name: Old Age Pension Scheme - Uttarakhand
benefit: A pension of ₹1,500/- per month is provided to eligible beneficiaries.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be 60 years of age or above. 1. The applicant’s family monthly income must not exceed ₹4,000/- or the applicant must belong to the BPL category. 1. The applicant must not be receiving any other pension.
